description: Fix worktree base branch resolution: multi-level detection, unified consumption, stale ref pruning, and merge base validation

tasks.title: Rewrite detectBaseBranch with multi-level probe
tasks.description: Rewrite detectBaseBranch() in src/git/detect-base-branch.ts to use multi-level probe: origin/HEAD → origin/main → origin/master → HEAD branch → 'main'. Each level checks existence before returning.
acceptanceCriteria: detectBaseBranch returns 'master' when origin/HEAD points to master
detectBaseBranch returns 'main' when origin/HEAD fails but origin/main exists
detectBaseBranch returns 'master' when origin/HEAD and origin/main fail but origin/master exists
detectBaseBranch returns current HEAD branch when all remote probes fail and HEAD is not detached
detectBaseBranch returns 'main' when project is not a git repo
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: See design decision D1 for rationale on probe order

tasks.title: Add --prune to smartFetch and merge-base validation after worktree creation
tasks.description: In src/git/worktree-manager.ts: (1) Change smartFetch to use 'git fetch origin --prune' instead of 'git fetch origin'. (2) After worktree creation, run git merge-base to verify the new branch shares history with base branch. If no merge base, auto-remove the worktree and branch, then throw error.
acceptanceCriteria: smartFetch runs 'git fetch origin --prune'
Worktree creation succeeds when merge base exists with base branch
Worktree creation fails with descriptive error when no merge base exists
Failed worktree creation auto-cleans the created worktree and branch
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: See design decisions D3 and D4. The merge-base check goes after the git worktree add call.

tasks.title: Fix CLI diff to use project baseBranch and API diff to use origin/ prefix
tasks.description: In src/cli/commands/issue.ts: (1) Remove the getDefaultBranch() function. (2) In the diff command action, fetch project info from API and use project.baseBranch. In src/api/issues.ts: (3) In the diff endpoint, use `origin/${project.baseBranch}` instead of raw `project.baseBranch` to reference the remote-tracking ref.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue diff uses project.baseBranch from API, not local git detection
getDefaultBranch() function is removed from issue.ts
API diff endpoint uses origin/${project.baseBranch} in git diff command
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: See design decision D2. CLI already fetches issue detail from API, extract projectPath and baseBranch from there. For baseBranch, add it to the API issue response if not already included.

tasks.title: Fix propose.ts to pass project.baseBranch to worktreeManager.create()
tasks.description: In src/api/propose.ts line 65, pass project.baseBranch as the 4th argument to worktreeManager.create(), matching the pattern in issues.ts line 331.
acceptanceCriteria: propose.ts passes project.baseBranch to worktreeManager.create()
No other behavior changes in propose flow
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: See design decision D5. One-line fix.

acceptanceCriteria: npm run build succeeds
Worktree for new issue has common ancestor with project base branch
